name: 弱酸温和水润洁面乳款
description: 雾蓝水景鎏金管身，弱酸温和洁面卖点套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: matte misty-blue #8FA2BF and light haze-blue #D6E0F0 fields, with pure white #FFFFFF reserved for packshot and information screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, upper-left key with cool white fill, gentle water reflections, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte backdrop panels with rippling water accents; matte light-stone counter for scene shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short headline plus small droplet labels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line droplet and sun-moon icons, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent scale for the tube across the set; props never cover the product
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh aqua skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty blue #8FA2BF, light haze blue #D6E0F0, champagne-gold product accent #C9A876 and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with gentle water reflections and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line droplet icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on at eye level, tube standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The cleanser tube stands upright, photographed straight-on at eye level, full product visible with nothing clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the tube. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 2K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off edges, no floating product without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒传达温和洁面水润洁净的核心利益
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle from a gently elevated position, product on the right
shots.lighting: soft studio key from the upper left with cool white fill, gentle water reflections
shots.background: matte misty-blue backdrop #8FA2BF with a soft palm-leaf shadow
shots.props: one clean water splash arc around the tube base; leaf rendered as shadow only
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top third for the headline
shots.textZone: top third 「{selling_point_1}」 with two small droplet labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Medium shot: the tube leans slightly and is photographed at a slight 3/4 hero angle from a gently elevated position, standing on a low plinth against a matte misty-blue backdrop #8FA2BF with a soft palm-leaf shadow and one clean water splash arc around the base. Soft studio key from the upper left with cool white fill, soft contact shadow. The product occupies 50-60%; generous negative space across the top third is reserved for a headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and two droplet labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」. Negative: no dense body text, no invented efficacy claims, no duplicated leaf textures repeating in the distance, no floating product without a contact shadow, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 放大油光、毛孔、黑头、暗沉等洁面前常见困扰
shots.camera: matched 2x2 grid framing, identical camera crop across all four panels
shots.lighting: even flat documentary light, slightly heavier on the concern panels
shots.background: white #FFFFFF layout field with four soft grey-blue placeholder panels #AEBACD
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the four panels fill the layout
shots.textZone: top band 「{selling_point_2}」; one corner tag per panel 「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen under a short charcoal headline in #33383D. Four equal rounded panels in a 2x2 grid, identical framing and lighting, each holding one abstract matte grey-blue placeholder block #AEBACD standing for a pre-cleanse skin concern (surface oil sheen, visible pore texture, rough texture, dull tone). {product} appears once in a slim banner beneath the grid, photographed straight-on at eye level. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. White layout field #FFFFFF, even flat documentary light. The product occupies 40-50% overall, no extra whitespace. Text: headline 「{selling_point_2}」 and four corner tags 「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」. Negative: no real model face, no gross-out or clinical imagery, no fabricated statistics or percentages, no garbled tiny text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用编号卡片讲清清洁机制，承接痛点给出解法
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front angle, tube upright beside the card
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: light haze-blue field #D6E0F0 with a centered white card #FFFFFF
shots.props: one numbered corner badge and three empty rounded image slots on the card
shots.whitespace: clean even margins around the card
shots.textZone: card headline 「{selling_point_3}」 and one support line 「{callout_7}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic card for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One large rounded white card #FFFFFF centered on a light haze-blue field #D6E0F0, framed as a medium close-up on the card; the tube stands upright beside the card at a slight 3/4 front angle. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. The card carries a numbered corner badge, a headline 「{selling_point_3}」, one short support line 「{callout_7}」 and three empty rounded image slots left blank as proof placeholders. The product occupies 50-60%, clean even margins around the card. Negative: no invented ingredient percentages or counts, no dense paragraphs, no fake certification seals, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以水波与悬停双管呈现配方温和的视觉主张
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at rippling water, tubes hovering tilted in frame
shots.lighting: soft studio light from the upper left, gentle reflections on the water
shots.background: misty-blue #8FA2BF with one crisp splash and ripple rings
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper 30% for a short claim
shots.promptTemplate: Formula feature shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Close-up: two identical tubes hover tilted above a rippling water surface, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the ripple rings. Misty-blue background #8FA2BF with one crisp water splash, soft studio light from the upper left, gentle reflections on the water, soft contact reflection under each tube. The products occupy 50-60%; generous negative space in the upper 30% carries a short claim 「{selling_point_4}」 and two droplet callout bubbles 「{callout_8}」「{callout_9}」. Negative: no plastic-looking water, no duplicated splash clones, no hands, no invented formula claims, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入日常洁面时刻，让买家投射自己的使用画面
shots.camera: eye-level candid framing with a slight 3/4 tilt, shoulders-down crop
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow
shots.background: light haze-blue wall #D6E0F0 above a matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC
shots.props: a folded towel at the frame edge, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: a generic young woman, framed from the shoulders down with no face visible, holding {product} at cheek height so the label faces the camera. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed as an eye-level candid close-up with a slight 3/4 tilt, shoulders-down crop. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow. Light haze-blue wall #D6E0F0 above a matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC; a folded towel sits at the frame edge without covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable face or identity, no deformed or extra fingers, no hands covering the label, no clutter, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用绵密细腻的泡沫质感证明温和亲肤的使用体验
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: directional side light from the right sculpting the foam with soft micro shadows
shots.whitespace: minimal, the foam detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of rich fine foam lathered from {product}, tight zoom on the foam surface with shallow depth of field and the foreground sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot from a clean 90-degree side profile at eye level to reveal the foam ridge. Directional side light from the right sculpts the foam with soft micro shadows. Neutral white background #FFFFFF falling off softly. The foam detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace since the detail is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no artificial bubble clusters, no plastic skin look, no extra text, no props, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用同框同光的两组状态对比给出洁净后的改变预期
shots.camera: two matched rounded panels with identical framing and crop, product beside the right panel at a slight 3/4 angle
shots.lighting: identical even soft studio light on both panels
shots.background: light haze-blue #D6E0F0 layout field with white panels #FFFFFF
shots.props: one small circular divider badge between panels with no text on it
shots.textZone: one caption line under each panel 「{callout_2}」 / 「{selling_point_5}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen, two matched rounded white panels #FFFFFF with identical framing, lighting and crop, separated by a small circular divider badge with no text on it. Left panel: a matte grey-blue placeholder block #AEBACD for a dull, tired pre-cleanse state. Right panel: the same block rendered brighter and fresher after cleansing, with {product} standing beside the panel at a slight 3/4 angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Light haze-blue layout field #D6E0F0, identical even soft studio light on both sides. The product occupies 45-50% overall, no extra whitespace. One caption line under each panel reading 「{callout_2}」 and 「{selling_point_5}」. Negative: no fabricated before-and-after skin results, no real patient or clinical photos, no garbled labels, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用规整信息表收拢产品事实，消除购买疑虑
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree flat lay, tube lying diagonally beside the table
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, soft contact shadow
shots.props: a clean two-column info table with thin divider lines
shots.textZone: rendered row titles only; every value cell left as a blank proof placeholder
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce product-information trust screen. {product} lies diagonally beside a clean two-column table, photographed from a top-down 90-degree flat lay angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Pure white background #FFFFFF, even high-key flat lighting, soft contact shadow. Row titles in charcoal #33383D (name, texture, suitable skin types, usage time) with one thin accent line in #C9A876; every value cell is left blank as a proof placeholder to be filled in post. The product occupies 50-60%, even margins between rows. Negative: do not invent weight, volume, shelf life, origin, certifications or test data; blank cells stay empty; no dense body text, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以早晚使用习惯收口促单，留下行动提示
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, tube centered on the backdrop
shots.lighting: even soft studio light from above with a gentle water sheen, soft contact shadows
shots.props: one thin-line sun icon and one thin-line moon icon flanking the tube
shots.whitespace: generous negative space at the bottom for the CTA strip
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_6}」 above the product; rounded pill CTA strip at the bottom 「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing promo for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube stands centered at a slight 3/4 hero angle on a misty-blue #8FA2BF backdrop with a soft water sheen, flanked by one thin-line sun icon and one thin-line moon icon suggesting morning and evening use. Even soft studio light from above, soft contact shadows. The product occupies 55-60%; generous negative space at the bottom holds a rounded pill-shaped CTA strip 「{callout_3}」 and a short headline 「{selling_point_6}」 above the product. Negative: no real discount numbers or countdown clocks, no QR code, no fake member badges, no invented claims, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：1 首屏为金色软管洁面乳立于雾蓝水景，水花与棕榈叶影、气泡角标与温和洁面大标；2 四枚水滴图标卖点条与『选对洗面奶』痛点引入，2x2 痛点格（油光/毛孔/黑头/暗沉为灰色占位块）；3 『三效合一』编号01卸妆卡片（三张灰色占位图）；4 编号02 氨基酸配方双管悬停于水波；5 编号03 植物成分清单与持管模特半身（圆点标签）；6 草本精华信息卡两枚；7 植物提取物卡与店主自述类标语引入；8 四组VS灰色占位对比格与产品信息表开头；9 参数表（规格/保质期/适用肤质/功效描述）与使用方法步骤；10 步骤白框与底部早晚洁面提示条。品类判定：产品信息表明写『氨基酸洗面奶』，画面为软管洁面乳加面部清洁场景，硬证据充分，判 护肤个护/面部护理，与源夹名方向一致；leaf 按弱酸亲肤卖点命名。已剥离：原品牌字与系列名、原文案原句、二维码与会员角标、模特面容与身份、净含量/保质期/产地/成分清单及全部原文数值与功效断言（改 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 或空白占位），灰色占位图不作为事实写入。
